context: An elder former banker and a younger CEO discuss politics over coffee
purpose: Teach: 国債/縮小/撤退/当面/討論/統制/私的/解散

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昨日のテレビ討論を見ましたか。与党が長期国債の発行をまた増やすそうですね。
lines.en: Did you watch the TV debate yesterday? It seems the ruling party will increase long-term government bond issuance again.
lines.style: Calm, measured, slightly weary elder banker tone with reflective pauses.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 見ましたよ。正直、当面の景気対策としては仕方ないと思いますが、私的にはやりすぎだと感じます。
lines.en: I watched it. Honestly, as a near-term economic measure it can't be helped, but personally I feel it's overdone.
lines.style: Confident, direct young CEO voice, articulate and assertive but respectful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 私的な意見と言えど、若い経営者の声は重要です。昔は政府がもっと厳しい価格統制をかけていましたよ。
lines.en: Even as a personal opinion, the voice of a young business leader matters. In the old days the government imposed much stricter price controls.
lines.style: Warm, nostalgic, gently authoritative elder tone with a hint of teaching.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 統制経済の時代ですよね。今はむしろ、補助金を縮小して市場に任せるべきだと思います。
lines.en: The controlled-economy era, right? These days I think we should rather scale back subsidies and leave things to the market.
lines.style: Crisp, business-minded delivery, leaning forward with conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 事業縮小と言えば、うちの古い取引先も次々と海外市場から撤退しています。
lines.en: Speaking of scaling down, our old business partners are pulling out of overseas markets one after another.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly somber elder tone, recalling past business connections.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 撤退計画を急ぐ会社が多いですね。もし衆議院解散になれば、政策がまた大きく変わるでしょう。
lines.en: Many companies are rushing their withdrawal plans. If the Lower House is dissolved, policies will likely shift dramatically again.
lines.style: Analytical, forward-looking CEO tone with measured concern.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 解散総選挙ですか。まあ、コーヒーをもう一杯飲みながら、ゆっくり様子を見ましょう。
lines.en: A snap election, huh. Well, let's have another cup of coffee and watch how things unfold slowly.
lines.style: Soft, easygoing elder voice closing the conversation with a gentle smile.
